module.name: no-vitest-imprecise-spy-assertions
module.description: Require exact call counts and numbered invocation arguments in assertions made with expect imported from Vitest.

scenarios.name: should allow explicit counts and numbered arguments
scenarios.given: expect is imported from vitest and uses toHaveBeenCalledTimes or toHaveBeenNthCalledWith
scenarios.when: the rule checks the matcher call

scenarios.name: should allow negated zero-call assertions
scenarios.given: Vitest expect or expect.soft uses not.toHaveBeenCalled
scenarios.when: the rule traces the modifier chain
scenarios.then: no violation is reported because the assertion requires zero calls

scenarios.name: should allow unrelated and shadowed expect functions
scenarios.given: expect is imported from another package or a Vitest alias is shadowed
scenarios.when: the rule resolves the expect binding

scenarios.name: should allow soft methods on unrelated objects
scenarios.given: an object other than imported Vitest expect calls soft and then toHaveBeenCalled
scenarios.when: the rule resolves the assertion entry point

scenarios.name: should allow matcher property reads
scenarios.given: a banned matcher property is read without invocation

scenarios.name: should ignore dynamically computed modifiers
scenarios.given: a computed assertion modifier has an unknown property name
scenarios.when: the rule traces the matcher receiver

scenarios.name: should report positive called assertions
scenarios.given: Vitest expect or expect.soft calls toHaveBeenCalled
scenarios.then: an impreciseSpyAssertion violation requests an explicit call count

scenarios.name: should report called-with assertions
scenarios.given: Vitest expect or computed expect['soft'] calls toHaveBeenCalledWith
scenarios.then: an impreciseSpyAssertion violation requests a numbered invocation

scenarios.name: should report last-call assertions
scenarios.then: an impreciseSpyAssertion violation requests a numbered invocation

scenarios.name: should report aliased optional and computed matcher calls
scenarios.given: an alias imported from vitest uses optional, computed, or promise matcher syntax
scenarios.when: the rule traces the matcher chain

scenarios.name: should report a called assertion after a non-negating modifier
scenarios.given: Vitest expect uses resolves.toHaveBeenCalled without not
scenarios.when: the rule evaluates the assertion modifiers
